import re
import socket
import urllib.parse

def task_func(myString):
    if not isinstance(myString, str):
        myString = str(myString)

    url_pattern = re.compile(
        r'(?i)\b((?:https?://|ftp://|www\.)[^\s<>"\'\]\)]+|(?:[a-z0-9-]+\.)+[a-z]{2,}(?:/[^\s<>"\'\]\)]*)?)'
    )

    urls = url_pattern.findall(myString)
    result = {}

    for url in urls:
        cleaned_url = url.rstrip('.,;:!?)]}\'"')
        normalized_url = cleaned_url if re.match(r'(?i)^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*://', cleaned_url) else 'http://' + cleaned_url

        parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(normalized_url)
        domain = parsed.hostname

        if not domain:
            continue

        try:
            domain_for_lookup = domain.encode("idna").decode("ascii")
            ip_address = socket.gethostbyname(domain_for_lookup)
        except socket.gaierror:
            ip_address = None

        result[domain] = ip_address

    return result
